records.semantic: The OS decides when applications receive CPU time and how much memory/resources they receive.

fields.label: Mechanism
fields.value: The OS decides when applications receive CPU time and how much memory/resources they receive.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Prevents a single application from monopolizing limited hardware and enables concurrent application execution.

fields.label: Conditions
fields.value: Multiple applications contend for finite CPU and memory resources.

fields.label: Scope

records.semantic: Hardware-supported segmentation or paging restricts which addresses a process may access.

fields.label: Mechanism
fields.value: Hardware-supported segmentation or paging restricts which addresses a process may access.

fields.label: Conditions

records.semantic: OS services are provided as libraries and composed with one application/configuration code into a specialized single-address-space image.
